Class CannonShot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.projectile.Projectile
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.cards.projectile.CannonShot
public class CannonShot extends Projectile
Represents a cannon shot projectile fired at a player's ship. Cannon shots can be either SMALL or LARGE and originate from a specified direction. This projectile can be blocked with shields if it's SMALL, otherwise it damages the ship.

      public CannonShot(Projectile.Size size, Projectile.Source source)

      source - the direction from which the shot is fired

    • CannonShot

      public CannonShot(Projectile.Size size, Projectile.Source source, int pathIndex)

  • Method Details

    • evaluateDefense

      public boolean evaluateDefense(Player player)
      Evaluates whether the player successfully blocks or suffers damage from the cannon shot.
      • If the targeted path is empty, no damage is applied and no defense is needed.
      • If the shot is SMALL and the side is shielded, it's successfully blocked.
      • Otherwise, the shot damages the ship via player.applyProjectile().
      Specified by:
      evaluateDefense in class Projectile
      Parameters:
      player - the player whose ship is being targeted
      Returns:
      true if the projectile can be blocked (via shield), false if it misses or can't be blocked
